title: A Homecoming for the Scholarship
author: Zephyrine Hartwell
blurb: Felix Vane, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
